camel_example: aliyun esa ListWafRulesets --region cn-hangzhou --SiteId 1 --Phase http_bot --QueryArgs http_bot --PageSize 20 --PageNumber 1 --SiteVersion 0
description_en: Lists the rulesets under the current WAF execution phase. Queries basic information and status of rulesets with paging support
description_zh: 列举出当前WAF运行阶段下的规则集列表，通过此接口查看分页查询规则集的基本信息和状态
kebab_example: aliyun esa list-waf-rulesets --site-id 1 --site-version 0 --phase http_bot --query-args http_bot --page-number 1 --page-size 20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListWafRulesets

parameters.description_en:
The WAF rule execution phase. Valid values:
- http_whitelist: whitelist rules
- http_custom: custom rules
- http_managed: managed rules
- http_anti_scan: scan protection rules
- http_ratelimit: frequency control rules
- ip_access_rule: IP access rules
- http_bot: advanced mode bots
- http_security_level_rule: security rules
